name: fireclerk
description: Command-line tool to inspect and control tabs in a running Firefox session, via a WebExtension + native messaging bridge.

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/fireclerk-*.tgz && npm_config_cache="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/fireclerk-npm-cache" npm pack --pack-destination dist
scripts.extension:zip: mkdir -p web-ext-artifacts && rm -f web-ext-artifacts/fireclerk-extension-*.zip && cd extension && zip -qr ../web-ext-artifacts/fireclerk-extension-${npm_package_version}.zip . -x '*.DS_Store'
scripts.extension:sign: sh -c 'set -a; [ ! -f .secrets ] || . ./.secrets; set +a; exec npx --yes web-ext sign --source-dir extension --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --channel unlisted'
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && node --test test/cli-arguments.test.js test/content.test.js test/errors.test.js test/extension.test.js test/install.test.js test/markdown.test.js && node test/bridge-test.js
